defective_pattern: Using single-match regex replacement (e.g., re.search without a loop or exhaustive tokenization) for footnote markers in OpenXML text nodes, and verifying only the footnotes.xml count without checking document.xml for unprocessed literals.
why_defective: If a text node contains multiple footnote markers, a single-match approach only converts the first one, leaving the rest as raw literal text in the output document. Checking only footnotes.xml yields a false PASS because the definitions exist even if the references are missing in the document body.
observed_symptoms: Raw footnote markers like '[^2]' or '[^3]' appear directly in the compiled DOCX body text.
Automated verification returns PASS despite broken OpenXML output.
Mismatched count between footnoteReference tags in document.xml and footnote definitions in footnotes.xml.
corrective_remedy: 1) Implement an exhaustive while-loop or re.split strategy to replace ALL footnote markers in every text node. 2) Update the QC script to mechanically assert zero literal '[^' substrings in document.xml and exact 1:1 parity between footnoteReference tags in document.xml and definitions in footnotes.xml.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Post-processing script uses re.search for footnotes without a loop, or the verification script asserts only the count of w:footnote elements in footnotes.xml without parsing document.xml for footnoteReference parity or raw '[^' substrings.
